newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CLP to integrate two business groups.
newsitem.headline: CLP to integrate two business groups.

text.p: China Light & Power Co Ltd said on Thursday it was studying the integration of two business groups this year but was unable to say whether the plan would lead to any reduction in staff.

"The company plans to integrate two business groups -- the transmission business group and the distribution and customer services business group," Cecilia Chiu, assistant public affairs manager, told Reuters.
"The objective of the integration is to improve efficiency."
Chiu said there were 4,000 employees in the two departments.
"Not until we finalise the future organisation can we tell if there will be a staff surplus," she said.
The Hong Kong Economic Times said on Thursday that China Light would lay off 1,000 people after it merged the two departments. Chiu declined to comment on the figures.
"We don't have any definite plans yet, we are still studying," she said. "The timetable for finalisation will be in 1997."
China Light currently has a total workforce of about 5,500.
